title: 第7章 还没开始浪呢第8章 完美杀人
content_zh:
算计个筑基境的镖头而已，对云极来说轻而易举。
要知道前世被他忽悠瘸的大佬比比皆是，何况一个程舀。
可惜没能套出程舀护送的货物是什么，否则还能做点文章。
总镖头亲自压阵，东西肯定非同寻常，有很多办法从中获利。
比如提前通知沿路的邪道强者，来一招驱狼吞虎借刀杀人，或者引动某处妖族势力围攻镖局队伍，鹬蚌相争渔翁得利，也可以提前设局用一招狸猫换太子，甚至暗中挖坑让其掉进去再出面营救，这叫雪中送炭借花献佛。
身为穿越者，套路多滴很。
不过云极没打算用。
初来乍到，刚来第一天而已，连周围地图都没熟悉呢，云极不想节外生枝。
刚要返回山庄，云极发现阮青璃一直望着远去的镖车队伍。
“看什么呢。”
“没，没什么。”
“是不是也想做镖师，等以后姐夫开个镖局，就叫青璃镖局，阿璃做总镖头。”
“啊？阿璃不行的，阿璃修为太低了。”
“又不用你押镖，怕什么。”
“总镖头不押镖，那做什么呀？”
“当然是做镖货啊，阿璃被人劫走，姐夫才有借口去灭别人满门，押镖才几个钱，这才是正确的生财之道嘛。”
小丫头满头问号，总镖头不押镖变成了货物，这种买卖好奇怪呀……
“阿璃不想变成百眼石，姐夫不要把阿璃装进马车里好不好。”阮青璃瘪着小嘴儿，委委屈屈的道。
“好，咱们改成空运。”云极说了句玩笑，奇怪道：“百眼石是什么东西？”
“镖货呀。”阮青璃指了指远去的镖局队伍。

“阿璃真厉害，说说，你怎么看出来的。”云极倍感好奇。
程舀那三大车货物包裹得严严实实，用了不知几层牛皮覆盖，从外表丝毫看不出线索。
“百眼石是很昂贵的风属灵材，含有风毒，阿璃是风灵体，离得近能感应得到。”
阮青璃解释的同时，小小的肩膀下意识的缩了起来，好像十分惧怕。
云极点点头，原来如此。
又问了问详情，得知货物当中只有一车是百眼石，其他应该是伪装，而且那一车百眼石是一整块，其价值难以估量，绝不少于两万灵石。
说实话，云极有点动心。
两万灵石！
如果弄到手，山庄能轻易赎回来不说，欠下的外债也能还完。
无债一身轻的感觉，自然很好，可惜云极欠的不止这些。
一想起珠子那三十万灵石，云极顿时没了兴趣。
况且程舀修为不低，身后还有天石城的地头蛇‘龙虎镖局’，以落云山庄的这点势力是得罪不起的。
回到山庄，云极让几名家丁带着切好的熊尸立刻出发，分为四处地点售卖，远近不一，做到万无一失。
随后将父母的遗体埋进云氏祖坟，上了香，烧了纸，出殡一事告一段落。
忙活完，已经到了晚上。
吃过晚饭，按照惯例长子要在灵堂守灵。
云极打算装装样子，半夜就回去睡觉。
又不是自己亲爹亲娘，意思意思行了。
灵堂设在后院，阮青璃始终陪着，小丫头一丝不苟的跪在灵堂前，大眼睛泪汪汪的，看得出她对老庄主夫妻感情颇深。
云极这才发现小姨子是一双桃花眼，眼角微微上翘，与杏眼不同，天生多了一丝妩媚。
content_en:
It's just a plan for a bodyguard in the Foundation Establishment realm, it's easy for Yunji.
You must know that there are many big guys who were deceived by him in the past life, let alone Cheng Bao.
It's a pity that we couldn't figure out what the goods Cheng Bao was escorting, otherwise we could still make some fuss about it.
The head escort personally took charge of the battle, so the thing must be extraordinary, and there were many ways to profit from it.
For example, you can notify the evil masters along the way in advance to use a move to drive away the wolf and eat the tiger and kill someone with a knife, or you can induce the demonic forces somewhere to besiege the escort team, and the snipe and the clam will fight for the fisherman's profit.
As a time traveler, there are many tricks.
But Yunji has no intention of using it.
It’s just the first day here, and I’m not even familiar with the surrounding map. Yunji doesn’t want to cause trouble.
Just as he was about to return to the villa, Yunji discovered that Ruan Qingli had been looking at the escort car team going away.
"What are you looking at?"
"No, it's nothing."
"Do you also want to be an escort? When my brother-in-law opens an escort agency in the future, it will be called Qingli Escort Agency, and Ah Li will be the head escort."
"Ah? Ah Li can't do it. Ah Li's cultivation level is too low."
"I don't need you to escort me, so what are you afraid of?"
"If the chief escort doesn't escort the escort, what will he do?"
"Of course he is a bodyguard. After Ali was kidnapped, my brother-in-law had an excuse to kill other people's families. He only paid a few bucks as a bodyguard. This is the right way to make money."
The little girl has questions all over her head, and the escort has turned into goods instead of paying attention. This kind of business is so strange...
"A'li doesn't want to become a hundred-eyed stone. Brother-in-law, please don't put A'li in the carriage." Ruan Qingli pursed her lips and said aggrievedly.
"Okay, let's transport it by air instead." Yunji joked and asked curiously: "What is the Hundred-Eyed Stone?"
"Escort guys." Ruan Qingli pointed to the retreating escort team.
"Ali is really amazing, tell me how you can tell." Yunji was very curious.
The three large carts of goods that Cheng scooped were tightly wrapped and covered with countless layers of cowhide. There was no clue at all from the appearance.
"The Hundred Eyes Stone is a very expensive wind spiritual material that contains wind poison. Ali is a wind spirit body and can sense it when he is close."
While Ruan Qingli explained, her small shoulders shrank subconsciously, as if she was very scared.
Yunji nodded, that’s it.
After asking for more details, I learned that only one cart of the Hundred-Eyed Stones was in the cargo, and the others were probably disguises. Moreover, that cart was a whole piece of Hundred-Eyed Stones, and its value was inestimable, never less than 20,000 spiritual stones.
To be honest, Yunji was a little tempted.
Twenty thousand spirit stones!
If you get it, the villa can be redeemed easily, and the foreign debts you owe can be paid off.
The feeling of being debt-free is naturally very good, but it's a pity that Yunji owes more than that.
When he thought of the three hundred thousand spirit stones in Zhuzi, Yunji suddenly lost interest.
Moreover, Cheng Bao's cultivation level is not low, and he has Tianshi City's local gangster 'Dragon and Tiger Escort Agency' behind him, so the power of Luoyun Villa cannot afford to offend him.
Returning to the villa, Yunji asked several servants to set out immediately with the cut bear carcasses and sell them at four locations, ranging from near to far, to ensure that everything was foolproof.
Then the parents' bodies were buried in the Yun family's ancestral grave, incense was burned, paper was burned, and the funeral came to an end.
After finishing the work, it was already evening.
After dinner, it was customary for the eldest son to keep vigil in the mourning hall.
Yunji planned to pretend and go back to sleep in the middle of the night.
It's not like he is his biological father or mother, so that's fine.
The mourning hall was set up in the backyard, and Ruan Qingli was always with her. The little girl knelt in front of the mourning hall meticulously, with her big eyes filled with tears. It was obvious that she had deep feelings for the old manor owner and his wife.
Only then did Yunji realize that his sister-in-law had peach blossom eyes, with the corners of her eyes slightly upturned. Unlike her almond-shaped eyes, she was naturally more charming.
